baseline_definition: The historical standalone evidence baseline measures progress toward four self-contained field units that do not depend on a phone, server, or repeater; it is retained for continuity and is not the current V1 Companion release total.

baseline_milestones.name: Architecture and safety contracts
baseline_milestones.description: Protocol, recovery, privacy, group-size, and degraded-operation rules are documented and extensively host tested.
baseline_milestones.next_gate: Close remaining product-firmware architecture gates with target evidence.

baseline_milestones.name: Core OpenTrail firmware
baseline_milestones.description: Hardware-neutral communication, status, alert, persistence, update, and recovery components plus a portable-client composition exist; real board bindings remain.
baseline_milestones.next_gate: Bind the selected client hardware and prove the complete target composition.

baseline_milestones.name: Firmware loading app
baseline_milestones.description: A packaged Windows inspection shell identifies the three bench runtimes, presents non-authoritative vendor-family hardware candidates with explicit maintenance steps, and verifies bounded bundle structure, image SHA-256, and RSA-PSS-3072/SHA-256 when a signer is pinned; production trust, authoritative board matching, writing, and recovery remain absent.
baseline_milestones.next_gate: Run separately authorized maintenance probes for received-board evidence, obtain independent trust review, and approve signer custody plus pinned production trust before implementing any writer.

baseline_milestones.name: Heltec V4 bench firmware
baseline_milestones.description: Two assembled Heltec V4 units retain bounded historical MeshCore bench evidence. OT-DEV-001 is an experimental OpenTrail target: its exact profile, physical boot and BLE advertisement, and target-local 128 x 64 startup/status OLED passed bounded write, verification, runtime, visual, and Android discovery gates. The exact installed partition table and complete blank protected-storage source region passed a bounded physical read-only proof, and the exact installed application is privately retained as a verified recovery artifact.
baseline_milestones.evidence_status: Experimental physical target with startup/status OLED
baseline_milestones.next_gate: Accept the exact recovery route, protected key roles, an independent rollback floor, and separate physical-write authority before any partition transition; then admit protected owner storage and private bond authority, prove one bounded GATT authorization and Ready session, and bind real LoRa/GNSS and interactive display/input before unit 2.

baseline_milestones.name: Firmware for the first complete unit
baseline_milestones.description: The display, internal radio/GNSS module, power path, enclosure, and exact production target still require a frozen build and integration.
baseline_milestones.next_gate: Freeze the exact hardware and complete one recoverable end-to-end client.

baseline_milestones.name: Four-person V1 field proof
baseline_milestones.description: Four identical standalone clients must pass recovery, range, endurance, usability, and repeatable field trials before V1.
baseline_milestones.next_gate: Run the frozen four-unit standalone pilot and accept its evidence.

release_tracks.name: V1 Companion
release_tracks.definition: A complete V1 Companion release means four Trail Essential device-and-Android-phone pairs can be installed, privately authorized, used for direct group communication and location awareness, recovered, and field tested without depending on a server or internet connection.
release_tracks.rounding_rule: Calculate the exact weighted result, then round to the nearest whole percentage for public display.

milestones.name: Architecture and safety contracts
milestones.description: Protocol, recovery, privacy, group-size, and degraded-operation rules are documented and extensively host tested.
milestones.next_gate: Close remaining product-firmware architecture gates with target evidence.

milestones.name: Core OpenTrail firmware
milestones.description: Hardware-neutral communication, status, alert, persistence, update, and recovery components exist, while authenticated complete-target composition remains open.
milestones.next_gate: Bind the accepted security, radio, GNSS, and persistence components into the selected Companion target.

milestones.name: Firmware loading app
milestones.description: The shared desktop loader provides bounded offline inspection, while production trust, authoritative board matching, writing, and recovery remain absent.
milestones.next_gate: Accept production signing and board authority, then prove bounded writing, verification, and recovery.

milestones.name: Heltec V4 / Trail Essential target
milestones.description: One experimental target has exact-profile build, physical boot, startup/status OLED, heartbeat, privacy-safe BLE-advertisement evidence, a bounded physical proof of the exact installed partition table plus complete blank protected-storage source region, and a privately retained exact installed-application recovery artifact.
milestones.next_gate: Accept the exact recovery route, protected key roles, an independent rollback floor, and separate physical-write authority before any partition transition; then admit protected storage and private bond authority, prove physical GATT authorization and Ready, and bind LoRa and GNSS.

milestones.name: Android companion application
milestones.description: Two of five equal evidence gates are accepted: build/install/lifecycle/artwork acceptance and exact-service discovery; connection, protected authorization, and operational release acceptance remain open.
milestones.evidence_status: Build tested with bounded physical observations
milestones.next_gate: Prove physical GATT connection and negotiation, protected one-phone authorization and Ready, then operational and release acceptance.

milestones.name: Four-person Companion field proof
milestones.description: Four frozen Trail Essential and supported Android pairs must pass recovery, range, endurance, usability, and repeatable field trials before V1 Companion.
milestones.next_gate: Approve the Companion pilot amendment, freeze four device-phone pairs, and run the accepted field sequence.

change_log.reason: Established the first evidence-weighted V1 Companion baseline. Shared architecture, core firmware, loader, and Heltec evidence are counted once; Android receives two of five equal gates for physical install/lifecycle/artwork and exact-service discovery, while live GATT, protected authorization and Ready, operational release acceptance, and four-person field proof remain open.
Recorded one consumed, sanitized OT-DEV-001 source-read denial and owner-observed startup/status return. Source proof remains absent, so no milestone completion changed.

Accepted the exact installed partition-table and complete blank protected-storage source-region proof on OT-DEV-001, followed by the owner-observed startup/status return. This satisfies only the source prerequisite, so no milestone completion changed.
Accepted a private exact capture of the installed OT-064 application as recovery input. The recovery route and every transition authority remain open, so no milestone completion changed.

release_tracks.name: V2 Integrated
release_tracks.definition: A future V2 Integrated release moves the user interface onto a dedicated touchscreen client while retaining the shared Trail protocol and safety foundation.
release_tracks.measurement_gate: Approve V2-specific touchscreen, input, power, enclosure, recovery, and field milestones before publishing a percentage.

baseline_change_log.reason: Established the first evidence-weighted V1 baseline for public progress reporting.

Added packaged three-device runtime inspection, candidate-only hardware guidance, bounded firmware-bundle structure/image-digest/host RSA-PSS, and fixed cross-tool vector verification; production signer trust, board authority, and writing remain absent, so the weighted percentage is unchanged.

Accepted the first pinned native ESP-IDF v6.0.2 ESP32-S3 build candidate with exact configuration, size, artifact, and incremental-build evidence. No device was accessed or flashed, and the generic image profile still requires an exact Heltec rebuild, recovery, and physical runtime evidence.

Accepted the OT-DEV-001-bound 16 MiB flash and configured 2 MiB quad-PSRAM build profile plus exact partition evidence. No unit was selected, recovery-rehearsed, authorized, flashed, or run, so the evidence-weighted percentage is unchanged.

Accepted one physical Android debug-APK install plus foreground screen-retention evidence. Canonical V1 remains phone-independent and no OpenTrail target firmware was flashed or run, so the evidence-weighted percentage is unchanged.

Accepted one owner-authorized OT-DEV-001 erase/write with exact post-write verification, physical boot self-check/USB heartbeat, and one privacy-safe Android observation of the OpenTrail BLE service advertisement. This closes the prior first-target physical gate but does not prove protected storage, GATT authorization, Ready, LoRa, GNSS, display, recovery-after-loss, support, or field use.

Accepted one bounded OT-DEV-001 factory-app update with exact read-only verification, owner-observed Trail startup logo and BLE ADVERTISING status, four USB heartbeats, and one privacy-safe Android observation of the exact OpenTrail service. This advances only the Heltec bench-target milestone; protected storage, GATT authorization, Ready, LoRa, GNSS, interactive display/input, complete-unit, recovery, support, and field evidence remain open.
Recorded one consumed, sanitized OT-DEV-001 source-read denial and owner-observed startup/status return. Source proof remains absent, so the historical baseline is unchanged.

Accepted the exact installed partition-table and complete blank protected-storage source-region proof on OT-DEV-001, followed by the owner-observed startup/status return. This satisfies only the source prerequisite, so the historical baseline is unchanged.
Accepted a private exact capture of the installed OT-064 application as recovery input. The recovery route and every transition authority remain open, so the historical baseline is unchanged.
